blocks.text: Lawrence Mangubat erupted for his career-best 29 points as Jose Rizal University ended a nine-year Final Four drought after ousting Arellano University, 81-70, in the NCAA Season 102 men's basketball quarterfinals on Monday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
